test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How many schedules are there in the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972 of India?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**VI**__**.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The** Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972** is an Act for the protection of plants and animal species.
 
• The** Wild Birds Protection Act, 1887**, was the first such regulation passed by the British Indian Government in 1887.
 
• Forests and Protection of Wild Animals and Birds were transferred from State to Concurrent List through the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976.
 
• India has only five recognised national parks prior to this legislation.
 
• As of 2021, there are **104 national parks **in India.
 
• **Schedule I** deals with the endangered species that need rigorous protection.
 
• The Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972, originally contained 6 schedules.
